notes.title: Zombies Mode Now Available
notes.notes:
Greetings and salutations!

Survival Games v0.11.9.0 has been uploaded to early access. This build carries a huge fix list, as well as an entirely new game mode.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/iFPAfA8dSDmB96ghY9/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Zombies Mode:[/h1]

This game mode flips the concept of battle royale upside down, with four players working together to defeat the hordes of undead instead of competing against each other. The game type takes place in the urban confines of City 26, which has been sealed behind walls.

The Dynamic maps from Battle Royale are also present in Zombies Mode. Each time you play, different buildings will be present, or in different states of destruction. Chests with random contents will also appear in semi random locations. Hard to reach places, will have the best tier loot.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/L2liHjzrQLMzIlpUO5/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Scenarios:[/h1]

A scenario is a level, or campaign within the Zombies Mode. Each can start with a different starting set of weapons, and will feature different waves of undead as well as different starting areas.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/e60a5ef2f6b52410c6597b56603fbf38815f2e03.png[/img]


[h1]The Zombies:[/h1]

Zombies are best killed with high power rifles, and automatic weapons. Guns are your best friends, but there is a myriad of melee weapons you can also pick up. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dBCBBmcqi3mlOp8ELg/giphy.gif[/img]

There are several varieties of zombies, but Suckers are a nasty little one, that will cling to your face. It's best to have a teammate shoot them off. But if you're alone, you can melee them off as well.

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/IcpB28CsukVHc4gg0S/giphy.gif [/img]


[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
This update also carries a lot of fixes and improvements. Please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/307150/discussions/0/1634111706735117576/?ctp=2#c1652171126116531151]click over here[/url] for the full list of changes!

notes.title: Devlog 42: Bots and Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Bots are coming to multiplayer, along with improvements to the matchmaking flow of Survival Games. Keep reading to find out what's going on.

[h1]Building a community[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/4a2d17c9e15b08b0d98e383820223c5466d30e41.jpg[/img]
When the 2014 edition of Survival Games shipped, the Xbox 360 player based simply existed from day one up until the end of XBLIG. Steam is an entirely different animal, so we at 2.0 at working on building up a larger community of active gamers. But it's a chicken and egg problem, where people want more people to play so that they as people can play against the people they need to play. 

[h1]Bots Joining You[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/etB9jJP3axmlGHr2uO/giphy.gif[/img]
We are implementing bots as a ramp, to get games going. Bots will join newly created games, providing the minimum players needed to play a round of Battle Royale. They'll also quit games with high player counts, as we want the gamers behind the keyboard to get the satisfaction of kills, not my code.

[h1]Bots stealin' yo loot[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/604fUIG4dv6vHPwfCv/giphy.gif[/img]
Survival Games has a lot of game mechanics. Scavenging, killing players, hunting animals and eating are a few of the keys ones. Bots abide by these game mechanics just like players, and can navigate the terrain as well as any player. They are also aware of advanced mechanics such as footprints, and buff characteristics of foods.

[h1]Spreading the Word[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KY5bqLXQrWhZ0E8GL2/giphy.gif[/img]
The most obvious way to grow the multiplayer community, is simply for us to advertise. Go get more people. We're playing the long game with Survival Games, and will only knuckle down on marketing when the game has solved all the technical methods of building a multiplayer community. You'll see gaming events, key give aways and few other things like that later on.

Community members have introduced us to things like SteamGifts, and Woovit which have been helpful! So if you know something, pass it on and we'll use it!

---

[h1]Follow Survival Games on Steam to receive notifications on update and events
[Img]https://i.imgur.com/1Xe8Iv8.png[/img]

[Img]https://i.imgur.com/e958TQ1.png[/Img]
▶ Follow us on Twitter! | https://twitter.com/2point0studios

[Img]https://i.imgur.com/iO7aD5Z.png[/Img]
▶ Chat with us on Discord! | https://discord.gg/DmkqnWk 

[b]Thank you for following and supporting our game!
2.0 Studios[/b]

notes.title: Early Access begins NOW
notes.notes:
Today is the 10th of April 2018, launch day. As of 10:00pm, you can get a retail copy of Survival Games, at the discounted early access price. What's next? Keep reading to see what's up.

[h1]Beta Winding Down:[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/47KTjR7vs5G3rbOtP2/giphy.gif[/img]
1400 beta keys have been given out and used by the Survival Games community. We're going to be closing down the Beta gradually. This means that Beta users, and Retail users will play together for a while as we transition from private Beta to Early Access. This will be complete by the end of April.

[h1]About Beta Keys:[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/9c8dcb4cbd595cf0424f1dc52ad5d0b917d4cacc.jpg[/img]
Beta Keys are not retail keys. They let you play a different version of Survival Games, before the actual launch date. All Beta Keys will all be revoked during April 2018. Consider purchasing Survival Games if you had fun, or want to keep playing. If you got a Steam key from the bot POP-L0ck over on our [url=https://discord.gg/tXhvUrT]Discord[/url], then you have a Beta Key. 

[h1]About Retail Keys:[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/5220c48ac4a01b9dec4f30a7f9b9ff23fbcb0c65.jpg[/img]
These keys are permanent additions to your Steam Account. You get these by purchasing Survival Games through Steam. The game modes coming later, are included in your purchase. So you will receive updates for Warfare, Zombie Survival and the Map Editor as the developers complete the milestones.

[h1]Milestones and v1.0:[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8Z2Zm7X8l1fOZ1jQ0n/giphy.gif[/img]
Each game mode, is a different two month milestone. We're launching with Battle Royale as the flagship game mode. Next, is Warfare Mode and after that is Zombie Survival. Finally there is the Map Editor with Steamworks integration. Version 1.0, is when all game modes are in and complete.

[h1]Price:[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1k2wsRAWUq9B1MkISr/giphy.gif[/img]
The full price of Survival Games is $19.95USD, but Early Access means that the game is not finished. So it is discounted to $9.95, with an additional 7 day 25% launch discount on top pushing it down to $7.47 USD

[h1]Update Information:[/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1dIvW3mBHBuCk41koo/giphy.gif[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/307150/discussions/0/1634111706735117576/?ctp=2]This thread[/url], is filled with posts about what has changed, been added or fixed. You'll also see us on our Discord channel, twitter and the Steam Community hub posting information.

Survival Games began development in 2012. Here it is in 2018, taking its first exciting steps as a Multiplayer Steam game. May the odds be forever in your favour!

notes.title: Devlog 41: Ranged Weapons
notes.notes:
Ranged weapons are what you really want to find in Survival Games if you want to be more than first day fodder. Keep reading to learn about four of our favourites.

[h1]Battle Rifle[/h1]
[img]https://imgur.com/QK2yAcj.gif[/img]
Medium to long range, with a three round burst. Load this beast up with Medium bullets and prepare to wreck face. Like all guns, there are rarity variants with the rarest blasting off four rounds per burst instead of three. And yes, it is inspired by Halo 2.

[h1]Flare Gun[/h1]
[img]https://imgur.com/gUuOo1x.gif [/img]
Yes I know, it's a nautical tool used to signal help and it's utterly useless in a Battle Royale type game. But it does deal decent damage at range, and start fires. This makes a great distraction, and it's pretty shameful to get finished off by one of these. 

[h1]SWAT Pistol[/h1]
[img]https://imgur.com/n6eHrvg.gif [/img]
When you combine a regular 9199 Operator with an upgrade kit, you get one of these sexy little pieces. They also spawn in locked chests. When you Aim Down Sight (herafter referred to ADS in respect to this secondary function in regards to operation with lethal intent) you get some handy dandy zoom. Oh, and it won't show up a sound marker on the map. Sound markers are something we're adding next update. Woot!

[h1]Shotgun[/h1]
[img]https://imgur.com/YJBny8w.gif[/img]
Imagine if Katniss or Shuya got their greasy mits on a shotgun? Eight shells can be loaded in, for some up close mayhem. Scrap blocks can be blown away with impunity, and even bronze chests can be cracked open with a few shots. Have I mentioned that locked chests can just be destroyed to reveal contents?

Well, that’s four guns out of 34 in the game currently. I hope this helps you win. I hope you all win. Every game. I'll be back soon with more helpful info.

 - Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 40: Tracking for Advanced players + Beta Keys
notes.notes:
You can track other players in two ways, but most players don't know how. And we've loaded P0P-L0ck up with more Beta keys. Keep reading for the deets.

[h1]Blood[/h1]
When hurt, all living things bleed. So when you are badly hurt, a bright red trail will be left behind. Crossing rivers and other water can hide the trail, but you really need to heal up. On the flip side, this makes hunting players and fast creatures (like cute bunnies) easier. 

[img]https://imgur.com/g4tUEV4.gif[/img]


[h1]Footprints[/h1]
Players leave behind footprints on soft terrain, such as grass. These are subtle dark spots, that can tell you if they are running or walking. Look at the spacing of the footprints. Since creatures also leave footprints behind, I'll be enlisting the help of a Penguin to help demonstrate.

[img]https://imgur.com/WT8SmUB.gif[/img]


[h1]Tracking[/h1]
These two combined, make finding weaklings who run away from you quite easy. If you are the hunted however, you should note that hard surfaces such as metals and concrete can't have footprints. However blood will stain anything except water.

[img]https://imgur.com/CFhywPs.gif[/img]


[h1]More Beta Keys[/h1]
Over on the [url=https://discord.gg/2KT3QFR]2.0 Studios Discord[/url], our bot has been loaded up with some more Beta keys. So jump onto the #Beta-Keys channel and say "I volunteer as tribute" and POP-L0k will DM you with a Steam key and instructions. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/65300b61d575162e223d733c58c789dc5fda63be.jpg[/img]


[h1]Launching into Early Access[/h1]
So we've run out of show stopping bugs and issues. This means we will have to resort to actually releasing Survival Games into Early Access! After launch, we'll be working with the community to improve and expand the game up to the final version, with all four game modes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/221e2de5bbfb3d4669ad854597c4f51cd7d44cfc.jpg[/img]


Our launch date is April 10, 2018.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Devlog 39: Blue Prints and Construction
notes.notes:
You can now build structures in Survival Games. This is done by finding Blueprint items in loot, and then using them. Keep reading to find out how to master this new dimension to gameplay in Survival Games.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jbwOyGCZdMbGTB14sU/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Gotta go fast[/b]
You don’t want to be stuck in the open placing blocks one by one while someone else takes pot shots at you. Blueprints initiate construction, and complete on their own after several seconds. This leaves you free to completely focus on your survival. Only the parts of the structure currently visible, will offer protection so stay alert until construction is complete.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/WNmim8alCEnaCT0Is9/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Drawing Attention[/b]
The “Scrap” material all blue prints are constructed from is unique to Blueprint objects. It’s also very visible texture, and this is all on purpose. We want players to easily notice structures and be drawn to them, which will inevitably start fights.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7YBZCoV4oFzvPC5rYu/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Valuable Contents[/b]
Some Blueprint structures contain more than just walls and obstacles. You’ll find kitchens, storage rooms and even instant gardens that you can loot for items. These are rare, and take longer to build which can attract opportunistic enemies lurking just out of site.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/32aMWoz9DeOaoOr4Ee/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Wood, Concrete and Metal[/b]
These three material types offer different levels of protection. Metal being the toughest, can withstand the most damage. Wood however, completes construction the soonest. Throwing down obstacles when being chased, and going full turtle are two examples of smart use of these materials.

[b]Inspired by a Legend[/b]
We saw a feature very similar to this in another wildly popular game, and decided that the addition of self-completing construction would be something incredibly fun for players of Survival Games. And yes, that game we were so inspired by is of course, the Command and Conquer series.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/dba2fb002ef6d881ab9140ca225effaac4c89374.jpg[/img]
[b]Block Engine Shenanigans[/b]
Survival Games is block game, so has a fully editable world. When you take resources from the map, they physically change the map for the rest of the game. If someone digs a tunnel and reinforces it with blue prints, you can later exploit their work for your own survival. This is also what powers the dynamic maps of Battle Royale mode.

We are now almost ready for early access, with the addition of this huge feature. Follow Survival Games, and add it to your wish list to be notified of updates and release!

-Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 38: Deadly Shield Dome
notes.notes:
A huge deadly wall of energy, that forces you all to fight to the last man. It's been in Survival Games since 2014, so keep reading to learn how to use it to your advantage.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/9631e2283d3a9926de19f4438eadf9230604d779.png[/img]

[b]Lethal Radius[/b]
Don't leave the dome, you will die at a rate of 10 damage per 3 seconds. This prevents camping scum from clogging the game when I'm trying play like an normal person. If it's worth the risk however, you can dash out for a chest.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/811b63b785fc2cc7a06e5f37df339d5fbc469636.jpg[/img]

[b]Staged Shrinking[/b]
The dome is not always shrinking, it has periods of safety. You'll get alerts, and the status appearing on the mini-map. When it does, you can outrun it. Because going flat chat and watching a soulless game rule glide past you and leave you to die slowly and alone brings no satisfaction to anyone. Players should be encouraged to kill each other, which is why we put a goddamned dome in the game four years ago. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/a7532f80d48ba7dc1733f6bcbc6938ad235d92d2.jpg[/img]

[b]Dynamic Start Size[/b]
Survival Games supports up to 64 players, but there are times when you either won't want a full game, or the matchmaking servers don't find enough people. We're an Australian Game studio, so we're quite familiar with what it's like to play a multiplayer game when the lazy peasants in the USA have long since gone to bed. The dome starts off smaller, and in a random location, which keeps up the player density needed to have fun when your game has fewer players.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/4bab0e0f1ff2961e8862ac867b370418e6d5ffa0.jpg[/img]

[b]No longer a Dome[/b]
Ok, so it's not a dome anymore. The shape is now a cylinder, which makes staying within the safe area less tricky. A curved dome has a roof, that lowers and kills players in high places as you can see in the image. This also means that the mini-map is more accurate when it represents a cylinder. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/fc601aa5a7a6c3245c209959c492ef9967ae171f.png[/img]

[b]Battle Royale Only[/b]
The dome does not appear in Zombie Survival or in any of the Arena Shooter Maps. It's function is to force players to fight each other, which is only needed in Battle Royale. Exploding neck collars, and game masters only really work in books and movies.

notes.title: Devlog 37: Chicken dinner
notes.notes:
Survival Games has creatures, lots of wildly different creatures that you can hunt and eat. Read on to learn about some that are in the Beta right now.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/c8f5b5e237f99fa53ae8a0315f94e79338b6acef.jpg[/img]
[b]Clucky[/b]
This humble bird is an excellent source of delicious meat, that can be cooked. These are common, and won't attack you. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/771c620368e33877ebce58b9ff77c7d99284517b.jpg[/img]
[b]Howler[/b]
A vicious member of the Canine family, this grey coated beastie will attack and eat you if it gets the chance. Be careful in forests, as this is their native home.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/38576e6462b72bff0bbe90f1c23116875ebefaae.jpg[/img]
[b]Hogger[/b]
Unlike it's piggy cousin, the Oinker, this beast is not afraid to attack tributes who get too close. Razor sharp tusks and a mean temperament make these a dangerous encounter if you want to hunt them for their meat.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/408200c77a6b79bc642d26bbdd8713bcf0145fb1.jpg[/img]
[b]Skeleton[/b]
They say that these were once pirates who had had so much mischeif to do, that death could not stop them. You'll find them around beaches and ruined pirate ships. They carry items left over from their days on the seas, so they carry a wide variety of weapons and items.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/f03df19d218e92318fb31729ab0775fe1326e99e.png[/img]
[b]Mushy[/b]
This bizarre animated fungus just wants to be left alone. They hide in the ground, and will attack defensively if you get too close. They have some kind of magic about them, and will drop magical items if manage to catch one.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/0a73bb72c8b53247a06a2289c76b43184a006912.jpg[/img]
[b]Pixie Pengwing[/b]
A tropical relative of the arctic penguins, these flightless birds are found on rocky outcroppings near water. They are harmless, despite their beady red eyes.

There is a bunch more creatures in Survival Games Battle Royale, with the Zombie and Uberhund being unique to the upcoming Zombie Survival mode. Most creatures you encounter have a hostile, and a passive variant which means this list is far from complete.

Creatures add a whole hunting dimension to these Survival Genre games, which clever players can exploit when they kite hostile creatures into fights with their enemies. How? Throw a piece of meat to a deadly Roarclaws and he'll follow you, but not attack you for a while. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/36d3baf5d1aea2a8deebaab8424e9e3c86d2dab6.jpg[/img]
Anyway, tell us what you think about these in the comments below. Let us know if you have any cool ideas, or noticed something when you encountered one when playing Survival Games.

	- Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 36 - Where to find loot
notes.notes:
In Survival Games, loot is essential to your survival. In this post, I'll be covering the many different ways you can get your gear in Survival Games.


[b]Wooden Chests[/b]
These common chests have decent gear such as melee weapons or a gun. You can tell if one has been opened, so you don't have to run into danger to check.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/d5bae9be0acd5b3d0c537fbdc7dad6fde22d4970.png[/img]

[b]Gold, Silver and Bronze Chests [/b]
These ones have better gear, like a legendary sniper rifle. But you'll need to find Bronze, silver or Gold keys to open them. Lockpicks will also open these, but will take a long time, so be careful. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/56bde6b1dad134e451950adf03cc66a15670d967.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/8fec681504c4d8a0457480af668034569535c099.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/7384f38cecc425fb2b0a42db7f1e595a79707e2a.jpg[/img]

[b]Timed Chests[/b]
These rare beauties have similar contents to Gold chests. But they unlock at a specific time after you interact with them. If you find one, that's already counting down, there is probably someone nearby waiting…

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/65e96b9f06d748aced188919b4c977929b08e0a7.png[/img]

[b]Spawners[/b]
You'll also find guns, ammo, food and crafting supplies just lying around in the wilderness or in houses. These come from spawners, which are randomly placed and have random contents.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/354d184c25bb5804fa108a273df7d47fd3569383.jpg[/img]

[b]Drop Pods[/b]
These fall from the sky randomly, and hit the ground with a bang. They can contain anything, from legendary guns down to common foods. Don't let them hit you on the way down!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/c17795b6e6b67683bc04a1806216788783f7ca2e.png[/img]

[b]Trees and Forage[/b]
Up in trees, you can find apples, voxel nuts and cherries! Hold down interact and the fruit will fall from the tree. There are others, so keep an eye out!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/6346178f229f7a33540cbdea6dba49c453b3585d.jpg[/img]

[b]Cupboards, crates and Fridges[/b]
Open the fridge, and you can get foods. There are also crates found in huts, and cupboards in houses. They take a moment to open, which can make you vulnerable.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/5a473a6d4ca07b9273365144f4505ca1e8712fc6.jpg[/img]

[b]Creatures[/b]
Slaying creatures gives you items. Chickens, pigs, even wolves give you meat. Some will fight back, like the Boars! There are also monsters, like skeletons and zombies. These guys are tough, but will drop items like swords or crafting supplies.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/b041c5f9d2da35ecfc27c9775e25b8e179c85aa4.png[/img]

[b]Perks[/b]
So there is a perk called "looter" that will give you extra stuff when you search chests. There are other perks that will also give you gear.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/875c0fb72c4e983895f61d454a49c81e34727888.jpg[/img]

[b]Other Players[/b]
The best place to find awesome gear, is of course from other players. When they die, everything gets dropped into the world for you to scavenge.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/17a5cb0613f48725264fdd3180783959aabb95b6.jpg[/img]

Armed with this knowledge, you can get a lot more out of each game than those that don't know. So go ahead, and wreck some face with those shotgun shells everyone else overlooked!

- Jarryd

notes.title: Devlog 33 - The Battle Box
notes.notes:
In this post, I'll be discussing the spawning system of Survival Games and how it effects the early part of the game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/f1e7ef25da434088d68bdfe61f9516979282877e.png[/img]

The Battle Box, is a shipping crate with some jet engines slapped on the side by the A.C.R.O.N.Y.M corporation. Players begin each round onboard, and can jump out while the Battle Box flies over random trajectories of the island.

After you jump, there is skydiving stage that lasts about a minute. If you angle down, you'll hit the ground sooner. If go for distance, and deploy your glider with [SPACEBAR] you'll take much longer. Upon landing on the ground, the Glider is removed from your inventory.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/706a52b260a0bdcd5528f1b61382eacf8ba3ceed.jpg[/img]

Aggressive players who land soon, will be rewarded with the opportunity to loot the world first. Players who are cautious, will likely make it to the end game. But they may lack the gear to triumph in the end. It's really your call every time you play.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8226098/a860300af437552f3e49e43a6a3b1d030da772da.jpg[/img]

Some readers are aware of the 2014 release of Survival Games as an Xbox title, and may be one of the 280,000 people who picked up a copy. I'd like to make it very clear, that the old spawn point system has been replaced by the Battle Box spawn method, as Survival Games player count has jumped from 16 to 64 players. 

I'll cover more differences and improvements from time to time in these posts, as what we learned from the 2014 release has had a strong impact on development today. If you have any questions, the dev team will answer them over in Discussions on our Community Hub.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Devlog 32: Combat (Guns, Melee and throwing)
notes.notes:
Wrecking face, hearing the lamentations of their women and driving your blade into them is the best part of Survival Games. So in this post, I'll talk about guns, melee weapons and nasty things you throw at other people.

[img]https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/DEBUG-Survival-Games-29_11_2017-11_26_24-AM.png [/img]

Onwards to glory!

Guns are what you really want to get your hands on in Survival Games. The guns in Survival games require you to find ammo, and a few special guns even have multiple ammo types. These include incendiary shells for the shotgun, and explosive arrows for the bow.

Survival Games draws inspiration from the Halo series, so you can melee with any weapon. This is doubly good, as you conserve precious ammo this way. You can't use guns when sprinting however, and Aiming down Sight (ADS) lends an accuracy bonus.

[img]https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/SMG.png[/img]

Melee weapons play a huge roles in books and movies, but tend to be forgotten by other Survival genre titles. Swinging a Katana using your power attack, and having your enemy block the attack with their own Sledge Hammer is a satisfying moment in combat. 

Wounded players leave bloody trails you can follow, and tired players will be unable to run. This makes recreating those brutal scenes from 2000's Battle Royale not just possible, but very fun!

[img]https://i0.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/melee.png[/img]

This brings us to the throwable weapons. Grenades, jars of acid, daggers and more can be chucked. Some, can be baked which allows you to time the explosions perfectly. Take advantage of this, and the destructible terrain to make a surprise entry to an enemy stronghold.

You can get to know the weapons when Survival Games launches on Steam, December 7th 2017. Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Devlog 31: Hunger and Sleep
notes.notes:
In this post, I’ll be covering some of the Survival aspects of the environment that can be just as challenging as the other players you are up against. Specifically, Hunger and Sleep.

[img]https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/CookingMeat.png[/img]

Let’s get into it!

You can equip powerful weapons and thick armor, but without adequate sustenance this is not enough. Simple fruits such as berries can be foraged for in the wilderness as they grow on trees or on bushes. Better than these, are the man made supplies you will find in buildings. These buildings attract players, so keep this risk in mind.

[img]https://i2.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/HuntingBoar.png[/img]

There are also wild animals, such as bunnies and wild boars. These will drop raw meats when you slay them, which are very nourishing, and even heal some of your damage. Boars, wolves and lions all know how to defend themselves, so be sure to bring a decent melee weapon along.

Hunger is linked with stamina. This is a subtle detail, that the more skilled players will take note of. The more often you deplete your stamina by running and power attacking, the hungrier you will get.
This brings us round to the risky business of sleeping. Each day, you become increasingly tired. The consequence, is that stamina will not regenerate. A tired player cannot attack as quickly, nor use power attacks and sprint. Sleeping is easy, just find a clear area and hold down the sleep key (H). It takes a three seconds to go to sleep, and three more to wake up.

[img]https://i2.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/Waking.png[/img]

Be sure your chosen nap space is safe before you drift off for the time needed to fully recover. There are beds, and these cut down the time you spend actually sleeping.

You’ll get to try all this out when Survival Games launches on Greenlight on December 7th. Thanks for reading!

notes.title: MIGW and December 7 Early Access
notes.notes:
This is devlog 30 for Survival Games, and I'll be covering our recent appearance at PAX in Melbourne.
 
You can keep reading, or check out the Devlog video. It's got Jarryd, one of devs (Netcode programmer) reading this post with some Zombies mode in the background.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mba-xJlbrzA

Down here in Australia, we have something called Melbourne International Games week. It is ten day event that draws over sixty thousand people. There are industry, educational and consumer gaming activities and events. The Penny Arcade Expo runs at the end of this, and goes for three days.
We at 2.0 Studios were offered a last second placement, to showcase our game as a part of PAX rising. This is a set of showcases from small indie teams with modest beginnings.
 
During the three days, thousands of people checked us out. We ran a live demo of Survival Games showing off the Zombie Survival mode in single player. We also showed Arena Shooter in a two player Multiplayer session. We saw all kinds of gamers ranging from MLG thirty somethings to adorable little kids jump on and try it. From a developers perspective, it was an incredible learning experience. We could see what delighted and what frustrated gamers first hand. This has already led to some big improvements to Survival Games.

[img]https://i0.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/MainMenu.jpg[/img]

We gave out hundreds of promo cards as well. So if you've come back to check us out after seeing us at PAX, thanks again! You guys offered some really insightful feedback, and it was just plain wonderful for us to you all having so much fun.
 
So in conclusion, PAX Melbourne 2017 was out first ever showcasing of one of our games in our eight year history, but it certainly will not be our last. In the next developer log, I'll be discussing the Point of Interest System in Survival Games, and how that affects Battle Royale mode.
 
Thank you for reading, and be sure check out Survival Games on Steam when it drops into Early Access on December 7th!

notes.title: Devlog 29 - Zombies, tributes and PAX
notes.notes:
[h1]Survival Games will be coming to Early Access on December 7, 2017[/h1]

Since the time of our last writing, Survival Games has undergone a massive transformation. It includes not just one mode of play, but four. There is also now 8 maps instead of one.

If you're one of the cool kids heading off to [url=http://www.paxaustralia.com.au/]PAX Melbourne[/url] next weekend, you can check us out in the PAX Rising section where we will be running four player rounds of Survival Games!

So let's break down the game modes this fantastic new build of Survival Games has:

[b]BATTLE ROYALE MODE:[/b]
This is the flagship gametype. Inspired by the 2000 movie of the same name, and the Hunger Games movie/book series, it pits a dozen players against one another in a brutal fight to the death. Large sections of the map change each time you play, and loot is randomly placed so that you can never memorise and own the world. And at the end? The dome shrinks. Take THAT campers!
[img]https://i0.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Gladiator.jpg [/img]


[b]ZOMBIE MODE:[/b]
Co-operative Survival is the meaning of this gametype. City 26 has been overrun by the hordes of the dead that you must fend off. As each day passes, they grow more powerful and numerous. Delve into the sewers, through the locked doors and be rewarded with the best gear. But beware, the foulest undead creatures love the dark and winding corridors.
[img] https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Zombies.jpg[/img]


[b]ARENA MODE:[/b]
Fast paced in your face shooter gameplay inspired by the greatest first person shooters of all time. In Deathmatch, collect weapons from the map and blow each other away. Many maps are tributes to legendary first person shooter games such as Halo, Unreal Tornament and Counterstrike. But remember, this is a block game. Terrain will be destroyed, and scorched a myriad of different colors as your play.
[img]https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/BeaverCreek.jpg [/img]


[b]MAP EDITOR:[/b]
Build your own maps block by block. Take the base maps this ships with, modify and invite your friends to try out your wicked new changes. Name nodes, weather controllers, creature spawners and more await builders. 


[b]DOUBLE MULTIPLAYER[/b]
We're also offering two different multiplayer modes. Steamworks for online play, with a quick and easy search and join system. Keep your games private, boot the fools or just drop into new public games whenever you are slain.

Local Network Play, does not rely on an internet connection. Lightning fast, and lag free the way you're dad's shooters used to be. This is perfect for those of you who attend public LANS or simply invite a few mates over for the weekend. We at 2.0 love LAN gaming, and deem this essential to a true multiplayer game.


[b]SINGLE PLAYER:[/b]
Survival Games is multiplayer game, that is without a doubt. Gamers who just want some alone time should know that without other players, creatures and the elements still make for incredible opposition. Fending off Zombies for days in game, or simply lasting as long as you can in the Arena by hunting food and building shelter keeps this game engaging. Oh, and you can always just burn a dozen hours building stuff if that's more your speed too.
[img]https://i1.wp.com/www.CraftWorldGame.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/steven.png[/img]


Follow us, and let us know what you think as Survival Games makes the push into Early Access and beyond!

Thank you for reading!
 - Jarryd
